tasks.short: Advise on selection practices and implementation

steps.what: Locate evidence and current selection procedures
Assess relevance and risks of alternative selection practices
Write advice and implementation considerations

loop.purpose: Express the psychologist's selected advice clearly
loop.check: Psychologist checks meaning, qualifications and every source
loop.stop: One revision then manual writing if advice changes or sources fail
loop.why_not_simpler: Case-specific qualifications need prose beyond fixed headings

steps.what: Discuss advice and implementation with management
Send final advice document to management

tasks.design: Configure a dated evidence library and advice headings in {DOCS}; use a bounded drafting loop only for the psychologist's chosen recommendations. Discussion and the final {EMAIL} send stay separate human actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant evidence is found repeatedly and recommendation prose is written afresh.
tasks.enabler_now: Linked references and constrained drafting can reuse material without choosing a selection policy.
tasks.still_hard: Validity, fairness and applicability of selection methods in the particular workplace.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable interpretation and frank advice to management.
tasks.altitude: From repeated assembly toward better supported selection advice.

evidence.claim: The digest reports NIP requirements for explainable, consistent, valid and non-discriminatory AI selection instruments; these are context for retained judgement, not a measured saving.
Evidence retrieval and drafting savings are unmeasured local design hypotheses.

assumptions: Advice includes a written recommendation and its actual handoff; candidate assessment and operating the selection programme belong to separate tasks.

The psychologist produces source title, date, passage, local context and recommendation points in s1-s2; all reading and capture time is included. Missing or conflicting evidence is researched manually.
Try native linked documents and headings before adding drafting; no automatic candidate ranking or policy decision.
The author saves the advice in the same document system during s3; no self-approval or save saving is claimed.
unknowns: Whether written advice and a separate send occur in this workplace
Permitted use of confidential selection information
research_questions: Can psychologists draft advice faster while retaining all source qualifications?

incremental.description: Refresh references and monitor draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Advice points and qualifications used for this management discussion; changed advice needs a new check
Exact final advice attachment, recipient list and message; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B100, R85, gross15, upkeep3, central net12. Low retains 19/20 lookup and 23/25 writing when local procedures are poorly indexed and most wording needs revision: gross3 plus 1 lookup saving=4, less3=1. High retains 17/20 lookup and 18/25 writing with a usable source library and partially reusable advice: gross10 less3=7. Judgement, discussion and send stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement employee selection programmes

steps.what: Define selection programme objectives and validity requirements
Retrieve comparable programme evidence and constraints
Write selection programme procedures and responsibilities

loop.purpose: Draft procedures from professional design decisions
loop.input: criteria, evidence and psychologist's chosen methods
loop.output: procedure draft with unresolved questions marked
loop.check: Psychologist checks fairness, validity, responsibilities and unsupported additions
loop.stop: One revision then manual completion of unresolved sections
loop.why_not_simpler: Programme constraints require varied explanatory language

steps.what: Configure programme forms and workflow fields
Pilot procedures and evaluate selection programme results
Communicate final programme procedures to implementers
Record programme changes and implementation issues

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} templates and {HCM} form reuse for the programme the psychologist designs. A bounded prose loop supports procedure writing; pilot judgement, implementation communication and later change records are distinct phases.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme instructions, pilot forms and change headings are repeatedly assembled.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable forms and source-linked drafts reduce mechanical preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Demonstrating valid and fair selection for the actual jobs and population.
tasks.human_edge: Designing defensible methods and resolving implementation failures.
tasks.altitude: More time to test the programme against real work.

reach.learn: Test practical failure modes before wider use

evidence.claim: The digest names NIP requirements on validity and non-discrimination for selection tools; programme design remains professional work.
Native form reuse and procedure drafting could reduce clerical effort without choosing people.

assumptions: The baseline includes programme design, form setup, pilot, communication and change recording; routine individual applicant decisions are separate.

The psychologist produces job criteria and chosen methods in s1-s3; s4 captures field name, response options, version and permissions, s5 produces pilot corrections, and s7 records issue and change date. Their capture time is counted; incompatible forms are set up manually.
Use current HCM form templates and document headings first; no autonomous scoring, ranking or automatic launch.
Ordinary author saves are retained within each writing step and do not create an approval stage.
unknowns: Who configures and launches the actual programme
Pilot validation requirements and permitted data processing
research_questions: Do reusable forms reduce setup without concealing invalid criteria or permissions?

already_counted.description: Review drafted programme and configure forms

incremental.description: Maintain templates and inspect drafting failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact final procedures and pilot corrections communicated to this implementation team; changed procedures require renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R84 gross16 minus4 upkeep gives central12. Low: unfamiliar programme retains all10 retrieval, 23/25 writing, 14/15 form setup and 4/5 change entry, so gross4 minus4=0. High: reusable procedure headings retain19/25 writing, supported form cloning retains12/15, indexed evidence retains9/10 and change entry4/5; gross11 minus4=7. Objectives, pilot and communication stay full in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define statistical questions, comparison groups and outcome measures
Retrieve outcomes and capture analysis dataset metadata
Check missingness, coding and comparable outcomes
Calculate specified statistical estimates and uncertainty
Evaluate effectiveness and limits of causal interpretation
Write analysis findings and reproduce supporting tables

tasks.design: Configure supported extracts and reproducible statistical scripts in {DATA_PLATFORM}, with native checks and linked tables in {DOCS}. The psychologist specifies comparisons, checks data exceptions and interprets effectiveness; the calculation step produces only the specified estimates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual extracts, cleaning and repeated analysis runs obscure reproducibility.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned scripts can repeat specified calculations and preserve their metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, missing outcomes, comparability and the meaning of workplace change.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing a defensible result from a convenient correlation.
tasks.altitude: From spreadsheet repetition to reproducible evaluation.

evidence.claim: Versioned statistical scripts and native data checks can automate repeated specified calculations; the timing is an E1 scenario.
The digest describes research safeguards for special-category data, which may affect access and permitted processing.

assumptions: This task ends with the analysis record; publication or management presentation, if required, needs its own priced send or presentation step.

The psychologist produces outcome definition, comparator, time window and model specification in s1. In s2 the psychologist captures pseudonymous key, cohort, outcome, observation date, source version and missing-value definitions; s3 checks them and records recodes and exclusions. Their time is retained; missing fields or failed diagnostics return to manual analysis.
Use native exports and existing statistical syntax first; no model chooses comparators or invents missing observations.
The machine calculation has no external effect and no extra author approval; normal internal output saves have negligible fully retained time in s6.
The proposed saving applies only where repeated extraction and calculation remain manual today; existing automated runs have no new saving.
unknowns: Availability and compatibility of longitudinal outcome identifiers
Permitted cohort sizes and disclosure controls
research_questions: Can identical estimates be reproduced from a frozen extract with all exclusions traceable?

incremental.description: Maintain scripts and validate schema changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R73 gross27 minus4 upkeep gives central23. Low: incompatible cohort metadata retain19/20 extraction,19/20 cleaning,12/15 calculation and9/10 report writing; gross6 minus4=2. High: stable outcomes retain17/20 extraction,16/20 cleaning,5/15 calculation and8/10 report writing; gross19 minus4=15. Specification and interpretation remain full; these are task-specific cases, not a percentage haircut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop interview techniques, rating scales and psychological tests

steps.what: Define skills constructs and assessment validity requirements
Locate evidence for interview techniques and rating anchors
Write draft interview questions, scales and test instructions

loop.purpose: Express the psychologist's item concepts and instructions
loop.input: defined constructs, item concepts and allowed evidence
loop.check: Psychologist checks construct coverage, wording, bias and source rights
loop.stop: One revision then manual item writing if meaning or coverage fails
loop.why_not_simpler: Question and anchor language varies with the construct

steps.what: Pilot assessment instructions and observe response processes
Record pilot responses and examine psychometric evidence
Revise psychological tests and document validity limits

tasks.design: Configure instrument structures in {DOCS} and native pilot-data views in {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded loop supports wording from the psychologist's own item concepts; piloting, psychometric judgement and final revisions remain professional work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions and anchors are manually rewritten while pilot records are assembled inconsistently.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured instrument layouts and source-bound drafting can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Construct validity, measurement equivalence and defensible use for selection or promotion.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising an attractive item that measures the wrong thing.
tasks.altitude: More attention to evidence for the instrument's intended use.

evidence.claim: The digest's NIP selection requirements support retaining human validity and fairness assessment rather than treating generated items as validated tests.
Instruction drafting and structured pilot records may reduce preparation time; no local saving has been measured.

assumptions: This is instrument development, including actual item writing, pilot response recording and revision; live applicant decisions are separate.

The psychologist produces constructs and validation criteria in s1, item concepts in s3, observations in s4, and pseudonymous participant key, item version, response and observation fields in s5. Capture and correction time is included; missing or incomparable pilot data are handled manually.
Try document templates and native pilot analysis views first; no autonomous test validation, candidate ranking or promotion decision.
Pilot participant time is unchanged; author saves in the existing system are fully retained and have no separate approval gate.
unknowns: Existing instrument templates and licensed item restrictions
Pilot sample adequacy and response-data compatibility
research_questions: Do drafted instructions preserve the intended construct across respondent groups?

already_counted.description: Check instrument wording and pilot evidence

incremental.description: Maintain instrument structures and audit drafting errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R85 gross15 minus4 upkeep gives central11. Low: unfamiliar constructs retain all10 evidence lookup,22/25 wording and14/15 pilot-data work; gross4 minus4=0. High: reusable instructions retain18/25 writing, compatible response fields retain13/15 pilot-data work and source indexing retains9/10 lookup; gross10 minus4=6. Construct design, pilot interaction and final psychometric revision stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep selection and measurement judgement with the psychologist while reducing repeated evidence and document assembly.
role.ambitious_version: A psychologist who spends more time validating workplace interventions and explaining their limits.
